# zabbix_host_group (Resource)

Manages a Zabbix host group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zabbix_host_group" "servers" {
  name = "Linux servers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the host group. Must be unique in Zabbix.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `read` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the Zabbix host group ID.
terraform import zabbix_host_group.servers 22
```
